artworks.title: Initial D
artworks.artist: Master of the Cypresses
artworks.description: The image features an oval shape surrounded by golden projections. The center contains green leaf-like shapes and golden serpent-like curves. Within is a pink motif. The design is symmetric and ornate, with vibrant colors of green, red, gold, and purple.

artworks.title: Initial L
artworks.artist: Master of the Cypresses
artworks.description: This is a painting with an intricate, symmetrical design featuring floral and vine motifs. The artwork includes a central composition of stylized flowers and curling vines in vibrant blues, purples, and greens against a golden background. The painting is framed by a border of rich colors and detailed patterns, typical of medieval illuminated manuscripts known for elaborate designs, delicate intricacy, and vivid coloration. The piece exudes elegance and craftsmanship with meticulous attention to detail and symmetry.

artworks.title: Initial D
artworks.artist: Master of the Cypresses
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript letter. The letter is decorated with a golden background and a design of floral patterns in blue, green, and orange. The design includes flowers and leaves, stylized in a medieval or Renaissance era. The outer part of the letter is bordered by a blue swirl. The artwork uses vivid colors and gold leafing, typical in historical European manuscript illustrations.

artworks.title: Initial U (?)
artworks.artist: Master of the Cypresses
artworks.description: This is a painting of an elaborate initial letter "L". The letter "L" is decorated with intricate flourishes that combine organic leaf-like motifs in vibrant green and red hues set against a gold background. The design is ornate, featuring spirals and pointed extensions extending out from the letterform itself. The painting style is reminiscent of medieval manuscript illumination, featuring detailed patterns and a rich use of color and gilding.

artworks.title: Initial N (?) with David in Prayer
artworks.artist: Master of the Cypresses
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling, facing slightly right with hands clasped in prayer. They have a grey beard, grey hair under a crown, and wear a red robe with fur details. In front of them is a book on a stand. The background has vibrant colors and patterns, including a border with gold leaf and decorative motifs.

artworks.title: Initial I with David
artworks.artist: Master of the Cypresses
artworks.description: This is a painting of a figure holding a tall column. The image features a richly dressed figure with a long beard wearing a crown, positioned in front of a decorative column and surrounded by stylized floral motifs with a predominantly blue hue. The background is gold leaf or a golden color, enhancing the regal and opulent feel of the piece. The outlines of the image have a pointed, shield-like shape, reminiscent of illuminated manuscripts or medieval heraldry. This is in the style of traditional illuminated manuscript art from the medieval period.

artworks.title: Initial I with David
artworks.artist: Master of the Cypresses
artworks.description: This is a painting of an elaborate decorative letter, likely the letter 'I'. The image features a highly ornate and stylized letter 'I' integrated into an intricate decorative motif with vibrant colors such as blue, red, and gold. The letter is adorned with detailed patterns and a rich background filled with golden elements. Within the structure of the letter, there is an ornamental figure robed in colorful garments. The composition suggests an illuminated manuscript style, typical of medieval and Renaissance art, likely inspired by artists specializing in manuscript illumination during these periods.

artworks.title: Initial C with David (King Saul?)
artworks.artist: Master of the Cypresses
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a throne-like position. He has a long, gray beard and a mustache, and his hair is gray. He is wearing a blue robe with white and black ermine trim, over a green garment with long sleeves. The man is wearing a golden crown with a fleur-de-lis pattern. He is holding a staff adorned with gold and is seated in a chair with detailed armrests and a pillow. The background has blue drapes, a checkered floor pattern, and is enclosed. The scene is framed within an ornate initial 'C' with gold detailing.

artworks.title: Initial L with Old Testament Prophet
artworks.artist: Master of the Cypresses
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated at a table. He is turned slightly to the side, with his right hand raised as if in conversation. The man has a long, white beard and fair complexion, wearing a blue robe with white trim. He wears a white cap and holds a pink book in his left hand. A scroll of paper hangs off the table, which also holds a globe, balance scale, and round objects. The background has a wooden panel, and the scene is framed by an ornate border with gold, green, and purple colors, typical of medieval manuscripts.

artworks.title: Initial D with David
artworks.artist: Master of the Cypresses
artworks.description: The individual depicted is seated in a regal position on a chair draped with a red covering. They have delicate facial features, blond hair, and wear a golden crown with a gemstone. The person is dressed in a royal blue robe with golden trim and gray cuffs, and black shoes. They hold a scroll with writing on it. Red curtains with golden cords frame the seating area, with floral and vine patterns in red, green, and gold on a gold backdrop in the background.

artworks.title: Khunig Ludwig ...
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a knight on horseback engaged in battle in a forested landscape. The drawing depicts an armored knight sitting atop a horse, wielding a sword. The scene is filled with other figures, both standing and fallen, surrounded by detailed trees and foliage. The sky is depicted with billowing clouds, and armor and shields are scattered in the foreground. The composition features intricate line work characteristic of woodcut illustrations.

artworks.title: Marggraff Hainrich in Marhern ...
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval interior scene. The drawing depicts an ornately decorated room featuring a canopied bed with intricate details. A figure in regal attire, wearing a crown and robe with a large halo-like design around their head, seems to be bestowing a blessing or performing a ritual over another figure lying on the bed. The architecture within the scene is very detailed, including a decorative column, patterned floor tiles, and a window through which an outdoor urban landscape can be seen. Another panel on the wall portrays a religious image.

artworks.title: Ain Man Schoss seinen nagsten ...
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed scene set in a dense forest. The horizon is not prominently visible as the scene is dominated by densely packed trees and foliage. In the center, two men are depicted: one crouching and looking around a tree, while another is aiming a crossbow. The artwork features intricate brushstrokes or line work capturing textures of trees, leaves, and clothing. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black to create a dramatic contrast between light and shadow. In the top right corner, a divine figure with a halo and a child appears amidst the clouds.

artworks.title: Ein frau aus Marhern ...
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman on the ground, with her entire body depicted, including her face turned slightly upward. Another woman is kneeling beside her, with both hands holding the seated woman's head. The seated woman has long hair, and her eyes are closed. She is wearing a long dress with flowing sleeves. Another person stands nearby, shown from head to mid-calf, in profile. This figure has curly hair and is holding their hands together in front of their chest. They are wearing a belted tunic and tights. In the background, there is a wooden table with various objects, including a jug and a couple of round items. To the left, an arched window shows clouds and a figure in the sky with a crown and a child in their arms. The background also includes a bed with a carved headboard, a pillow, and bedding in what appears to be an indoor setting with stone walls.

artworks.title: Ain Man ward mit ainer Puren ...
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of a forest scene with a man aiming a rifle towards another figure. Above them is a celestial figure holding a child, surrounded by clouds. The style is reminiscent of woodcut illustrations with detailed lines. Text at the bottom of the image appears to be in a German-like language.

artworks.title: Hanns Krumbel von Ewsitz... d'organdie
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior space with a religious vision. The artwork features a detailed interior space with a seated figure on a bed, enveloped in garments, looking up towards an ethereal scene. Above, in the skies, a celestial figure appears surrounded by swirling clouds. The composition shows a finely detailed architectural setting with a combination of stone and brick walls, arches, and window openings. The room is furnished with a table set with a variety of items. The artistic style is characterized by intricate lines and cross-hatching, typical of woodcut prints, creating a dynamic texture and capturing a significant moment of intense reflection or revelation within the space.

artworks.title: Ein Man mit seine eelicheu gemachel ...
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell

artworks.title: Aines armen man khind fiel ...
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a scene with a well, a church, and celestial figures in the sky. The detailed line work shows a figure holding another figure next to the well. Two crowned figures are seen in the swirling clouds above. The architecture includes a large church with pointed rooftops, a smaller structure, and an archway. The sky is filled with swirling clouds. A well with a chain-suspended bucket is shown, and there is a sense of action in the figures' body language. The drawing suggests themes of divine intervention and reverence.

artworks.title: Ain khnab von Mansee wardt ..
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a celestial apparition inside a room. The left panel shows a framed opening revealing a landscape with a divine figure surrounded by clouds emitting rays of light from their head. Below are mountainous terrains, forests, and buildings. The right side of the drawing shows two figures in a room, with one appearing lifeless and the other cradling them while raising an arm upward. The floor is depicted with linear patterns to signify wooden floorboards. The style of the drawing is detailed and intricate, reminiscent of early modern-era woodcuts or prints.

artworks.title: Ain erber man von Lanshuet ...
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling with hands clasped in front of them, facing an altar with intricate patterns. The individual wears a long robe with fur trim on the shoulders and has curly shoulder-length hair. On the altar is a painting or panel of Madonna and Child with ornate decorations. Two candlesticks are on either side. Through an arched doorway in the background is a pastoral landscape with a horse rider and distant church steeple among trees under a partly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Zway khindt aus Windischlanndt ...
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell
artworks.description: This image features a divine figure holding a child emerging from the clouds in the top left corner. Below, a detailed town scene with various buildings, including a grand building with gothic windows and a spire, is shown. In the foreground, a domestic setting includes figures interacting, with a baby on a table and another one on the floor. The artwork is intricate, with various textures and expressive line work, reminiscent of a detailed woodcut or engraving. Historic script at the bottom likely provides context for the scene.

artworks.title: Ein Briester wardt gefanngen ...
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell
artworks.description: This is a black and white illustration of a heavenly figure above a group of armed figures below. The ethereal figure emerges from a cloud formation in the sky, overlooking a scene below. Below, elaborately dressed figures, some holding spears and banners, appear in a forested area. The foreground includes figures in dramatic poses, with expressive gestures and detailed facial features. The scene is framed by swirling cloud formations and stylized trees with dense foliage, rich with motion and narrative tension.

artworks.title: Ain iunger Khnacht von Znaym ...
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene in an interior space. The image features an interior with ornate architectural features including columns and arched stained glass windows. In the center, there is an altar adorned with a hanging tapestry depicting a religious figure holding a child. Above, a similar motif is on display, shrouded in clouds with beams of light. Surrounding the altar, there are several robed figures engaged in a discussion or interaction, pointing and gesturing towards each other. The surrounding details, such as the intricate details of the robes and architectural elements, suggest careful attention to design and ornamentation. Below the scene is a script or text.

artworks.title: Ein man wardt auff ain Rad ...
artworks.artist: Master of the Miracles of Mariazell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man being tortured on a wheel with other figures observing or lamenting. The scene shows a man bound to a wheel at the center, tilted diagonally. Surrounding the wheel are architectural elements like ornate railings and columns, and a figure in the clouds is present. Carved ornamental details are visible throughout the structure.
